payload.stem: In modern React web applications, which technique best minimizes re-render churn during Web Performance & Vitals?

options.text: Colocating state locally and applying startTransition for deferred background rendering
Using a single global context for all frequent state updates
Mutating the window object directly in component bodies
Wrapping all elements in nested setTimeout calls

criteria.name: State Architecture
criteria.description: Selects state colocation and concurrent transitions.

model_answer: Option A is correct: colocating state isolates re-renders to leaf nodes, while transitions prevent blocking main thread input.
explanation: Broad context subscriptions trigger re-renders across all consuming components. State colocation limits the diffing subtree.

payload.stem: Design an interactive UI architecture ensuring sub-50ms Interaction to Next Paint (INP) when implementing Web Performance & Vitals.
payload.context: A high-frequency dashboard displays updating tables with thousands of items. Users report noticeable sluggishness on typing.

criteria.name: DOM Virtualization & Containment
criteria.description: Recommends virtual windowing and CSS containment.

model_answer: We employ DOM virtualization to render only visible items in the viewport, isolate paint with CSS `contain: strict`, and offload calculations to a Web Worker.
explanation: Limiting DOM node volume keeps layout calculation times within the 16ms frame budget, optimizing INP scores.
